name: repo-pulse-ai
description: Autonomous AI Maintainer Harness, AWS Cloud FinOps Engine & Multi-Model Gateway powered by Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Nova, Bedrock Guardrails & Model Context Protocol

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/server/assets', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('src/server/assets/studio.html', 'dist/server/assets/studio.html'); fs.copyFileSync('src/server/assets/auth.html', 'dist/server/assets/auth.html');"
scripts.test: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const files = fs.readdirSync('dist/tests').filter(f => f.endsWith('.test.js')).map(f => path.join('dist/tests', f)); const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const res = spawnSync('node', ['--test', ...files], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(res.status);"
